user.title: UK Prepper Hub Alerts
user.description:
Met Office weather warnings, flood warnings and river levels near your home (England for now), and the UK Prepper Hub daily news.

We've picked **{region}** from your Home Assistant home location. Change it if that's wrong. Flood warnings and river levels use your home location, rounded to about 1 km.

Phones ticked below get an alert when a warning at or above the levels you choose is issued near you.
